name: mangacount
description: MangaCount is a local-first desktop manga collection manager (Electron + SQLite) with a React renderer and a shared recommendation engine.

scripts.test: node --test electron/main/db/client.test.js electron/main/db/repositories/repositories.test.js electron/main/services/entries.test.js electron/main/services/catalog-base.test.js electron/main/services/recommendations.test.js electron/main/services/platform.test.js electron/main/ipc/roundtrip.test.js electron/main/ipc/settings.test.js electron/main/lifecycle.test.js electron/main/services/backup.test.js electron/main/services/auto-backup.test.js electron/main/services/search.test.js electron/main/services/discord-bot.test.js electron/main/services/autostart.test.js electron/main/services/secrets.test.js electron/main/services/updates.test.js electron/main/services/diagnostics.test.js electron/main/services/covers.test.js electron/main/services/update-controller.test.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux deb AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never

author: MangaCount
